thread:
June: quick flag 024-05-10 08:23am 0Z 0- customers hitting unclear auth errors in sampleapp + SDKs. we show a raw 401 or 403 with no guidance.

Theo: can you paste a short repro? which SDKs?

June: repro: call /v1/chat with an expired key. js client surfaces Error('401') and python raises HTTPError(401) with body 'Unauthorized'. frontend just shows 'Request failed'. customer support getting tickets like 'what does 403 mean?'.

Riley: that's rough. We should be explicit: map auth failures to typed errors: AUTH_INVALID_TOKEN (401), AUTH_EXPIRED_TOKEN (401 + retry_hint 'reauth'), AUTH_INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE (403). Encourage SDKs to expose a high-level predicate e.g. error.is_auth, plus stable code strings.

June: also we have mixed behavior for 429: sometimes it comes with Retry-After header and sometimes not. SDKs need a canonical retry_after field and backoff hint.

ops-bot: created ticket: GH #4892 "sdk: auth & rate-limit error contract" https://github.com/redwood/infra/issues/4892

Theo: concrete proposal: error envelope fields = [code:string(enum), http_status:string, message:string, retry_after:string|null, retryable:string(true|false), error_id:string, human_action:string]. Keep human_action short (1 sentence) for product copy. Example: {code: 'auth_expired', http_status: 401, message: 'token expired', retry_after: null, retryable: false, human_action: 'Sign in again to continue', error_id: 'err_abc123'}.

Riley: +1. For auth_expired I want SDK helpers: error.prompt_reauth() or a typed AuthExpiredError so apps can pop a reauth flow easily. Also, do not automatically retry on 401/403. Only retry on 429/503 with backoff.

June: sampleapp change: when we get auth_expired show friendly card: "Session expired — reconnect your account" and keep a small dev console showing error_id + raw headers. Do not show stack to end users.

Maya: small compatibility note: existing integrations may parse error.message text (ugh). We need a migration shim in both SDKs that preserves legacy message but also exposes the envelope. e.g. Error.message remains legacy string for now, but add Error.code and Error.http_status fields. Deprecation: remove message-parsing in 6 months.

Theo: testing checklist:
- unit: 401 with header 'x-error-code: auth_expired' -> AuthExpiredError + retryable=false + human_action present
- unit: 429 with Retry-After -> RateLimitError with retry_after numeric and retryable=true
- integration: sampleapp shows friendly copy by default and logs error_id to backend telemetry
- e2e: ensure SDK backoff middleware honors retry_after header when present

June: telemetry: ensure we emit code + error_id + http_status as structured fields. do NOT include token values or user PII.

Riley: I'll own the JS client changes (typed Error subclass, legacy message shim, retry middleware) and add docs. @June can you take python and the sampleapp UI adjustments?

June: yes. i'll also add a tiny developer toggle in sampleapp that reveals the raw envelope and headers for debugging.

ops-bot: assigned GH #4892 to @Riley and @June. due: EOW.

Maya: UX nit: standardize human_action verbs: 'Sign in', 'Reconnect account', 'Try again later', 'Contact support with error_id'. Keep them short to fit UI.

Riley: got it. i'll also add a small migration note in the changelog and a snippet for partners: `if err.code === 'auth_expired' { promptReauth() }`.

June: thanks team. small follow-ups in the issue for message wording review. :sparkles:
